leads.organizations: Organizations you belong to or work with, your default, and company accounts.

common.offlineQueues: You're offline. Changes save on this phone and upload when you're back online.
common.offlineNeeds: This needs a connection. Connect, then try again.
common.offlineFirst: Connect once to load this section. After that it opens offline too.
common.queued: Saved on this phone. It uploads when you're back online.
common.loadFailed: This could not be loaded. Check your connection, then try again.

profile.skillsOffline: Choosing a skill needs a connection.
profile.dateHelp: Year, month and day, for example 2026-05-01.

privacy.blockedIntro: You don't see posts, comments, shout-outs or messages from anyone you block. Unblock to see them again.
privacy.unblockFailed: {name} could not be unblocked. Try again.

account.fullNameHelp: As you write it. Your crews and the organizations you work with see it.

providers.email: Email and password or email link

security.passwordBody: Change the password you sign in with, or set one if you sign in with Google or an email link. You're told by email and in your Inbox.
security.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters, with letters and digits.
security.passwordChanged: Your password is changed. Your other devices stay signed in; sign them out below if you need to.
security.codeSent: You signed in more than a day ago, so we emailed a code to {email}. Enter it, then change your password.
security.enrollSentence: Open your authenticator app with the button below, or add the setup key to it, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.setupKeyHelp: Select it to copy it into your authenticator app.
security.keysInGateway: Add a security key in Gateway
security.keysInGatewayHelp: Security keys and passkeys belong to a web address, so you add them in Gateway, Settings, Security.
security.recoveryLowOne: Only {count} code left. Make a new set soon.
security.recoveryLowOther: Only {count} codes left. Make a new set soon.
security.signedOutOthersNone: No other session was signed in.

errors.passwordContext: Leave out your name, your email and product names.
errors.emailCode: Enter the code from the email we just sent.
errors.samePassword: That is your current password. Choose a new one.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too easy to guess or was found in a data breach. Choose another.

stepUp.recoverySentence: Enter one of your saved recovery codes. Each code works once.
stepUp.elsewhere: Your second factor is a security key, which Compass can't use. Confirm it's you in Gateway, Settings, Security, then make this change there.

organizations.defaultHelp: Your default organization is the one Atlas and the API act in, and the one Compass opens on a phone that hasn't opened another.
organizations.engagedHelp: These organizations engaged you. Open one to see its work; an engagement ends with its contract, not here.
organizations.leaveAccountBody: You lose access to {org}'s company account at once. Your own profile and documents stay yours.
organizations.accountsNone: You don't belong to a company account.

payoutTax.noPayouts: No payout destinations yet. Each organization sets up where it pays you with its payment provider, usually during onboarding.
payoutTax.addressHelp: Organizations need the name and mailing address on your W-9 for the 1099-NEC they file at year end. Offline, it saves on this phone and uploads when you're back online.
payoutTax.addressIncomplete: Give the street address, city and postal code as they appear on the form.
payoutTax.giveTaxFormReason: Opens Gateway. A tax form goes to the organization that asks for it, from that engagement's onboarding, and Compass has no engagement screen.

calendarFeeds.linkHelp: Copy or share the link now. It's shown only once; after you leave this screen you can only get a new one.
calendarFeeds.rotated: New link issued. The old link stopped working.
calendarFeeds.revoked: Feed revoked. Its link stopped working.

connections.gone: That's no longer there. The list is up to date.
connections.disconnected: {app} can no longer act for you.

developer.description: Tokens let your own scripts call the XOS API as you, each in one organization and limited to the areas you chose. Revoke one as soon as you stop using it or think someone else has it.
developer.createReason: Opens Gateway. A token is shown only once and belongs on the computer that runs your script, so create it there. Creating one also asks for your second factor.
developer.revoked: {name} is revoked. Scripts using it stop working at once.
